items.project: W Residences Dubai – Jumeirah Lakes Towers
items.title: Phase 3 of W Residences Dubai JLT released with larger residences
items.summary: Phase 3 adds larger 2- and 3-bedroom residences in the 187-residence W-branded tower, with a two-day open house on 21–22 Nov 2026. Starting from AED 4M.
items.source: Middle East Business News and Information (mid-east.info)
